**What it is:** An NCLEX-PN study remediation CLI for Emeka. Reads a JSON file of missed questions (topic, client need, why missed) and generates customizable study plans (default 7 days). Includes a "days studied in a row" counter for motivation tracking via a local journal.

**Rules anyone must follow:**
1. Standard library only — no external dependencies

6. No gamification, streaks, or leaderboards
